title: D3 DDL applied as extracted, and the fixed copy
question: Does D3's DDL (every sql block of §3–§8, extracted by script) apply on PostgreSQL 18.6 with pg_textsearch and vector, as a non-superuser in a database cloned from the template?
method: Blocks extracted from D3 by code/s6_extract_ddl.py (SQL blocks identical in the baseline 35ea59a D3 and the working tree); applied statement by statement under savepoints as cs_s6_app; fixes applied in a copy from code/s6_ddl_fixes.py. PostgreSQL 18.6 (Ubuntu 18.6-1.pgdg24.04+2), pg_textsearch 1.5.1, vector 0.8.7, on the project-local cluster (just db-up; socket build/pg/run, port 5440, pg_textsearch preloaded); DDL applied and rows written as the NOLOGIN non-superuser cs_s6_app (SET ROLE) in cs_spike_s6 cloned from cs_template; psycopg 3.3.6 (binary), pgvector-python 0.5.1, spike venv checked against the lock (`uv sync --locked --check`: no changes) before the final run; free disk 109G at start, 106G at end.

agents.separation: coordinator brief; wrote only code/s6_*, code/s6*.py/.sql, results/s6/, records/s6.*

results.name: errors_as_written
results.note: CREATE INDEX segment_bm25: 22P02 invalid input syntax for type oid "english" (regconfig = unknown resolves to oid = oid)

results.name: fixes
results.note: F1 (error) ts_config = 'english'::regconfig in the BM25 predicate, also needed in the repeated query predicate; F2 (gap) CHECK on kb.segment.kind with the D1 §3.2 kinds, which the column comment promises

results.name: b7_columns_needed_fixes
results.note: golden_pass.model and inputs, split 'reserved', golden_item.context already in D3

results.name: create_extension_as_app
results.note: D3 §3 premise holds: neither extension is trusted

conclusion: D3's DDL applies with one error fix and one gap fix: the regconfig literal in the BM25 partial index predicate needs ::regconfig (and so does every query repeating it), and kb.segment.kind gets the CHECK its comment promises. Everything else, the B7 columns included, applies as written by a non-superuser; the extension premises and the migration's assertion behave as D3 §3 says.
